reason: The formatting foundation at 2a8c8e8b omitted standard HTML body parsing. The detector fires on that committed schema and stays quiet after explicit paragraph, heading and list parsers are added. Fixtures protect standard marks and nested list parsing through normalized wrappers. New private-layout invariants extend the same package, authoritative text, detached read and link rules to rich tables, and retain native focus traversal at table edges. The Tab and normalized-list defects were reproduced in uncommitted source, so no introducing commit exists for them. Literal AST checks do not prove aliases, transitive activation, rich paste semantics or output fidelity; mounted-engine, browser and rendered-artifact evidence remain necessary.
